title: About Us & Principal
answer:
🏛️ **About RV Pre-University College Harohalli**:

RVPU Harohalli is a premier Pre-University institution managed by the renowned Rashtreeya Sikshana Samithi Trust (RSST), upholding over 80+ years of educational excellence. Affiliated with the Karnataka Pre-University Education Board (DPUE), the college is recognized for delivering outstanding board exam results, integrated competitive coaching, state-of-the-art laboratory training, and holistic student character development.

title: Admission Procedure & Steps
answer:
📝 **Admission Procedure at RVPU Harohalli**:

1. Application forms obtainable post-SSLC result announcement.
2. Submission of application with passport photographs & 10th marksheet.
3. Cut-off percentage determination & Merit List announcement.
4. Admission finalized on first-come, first-served basis per merit list.

💡 **Tips**: Admissions commence immediately following the declaration of Class 10 / SSLC board exam results. We advise applying early as seats are allotted on merit and first-come, first-served basis.

title: Required Documents for Admission
answer:
📄 **Documents Required for Admission at RVPU Harohalli**:

• SSLC / 10th standard original marks card + photocopies
• Aadhaar card (photocopy)
• Transfer Certificate (TC) from previous school/institution
• Conduct Certificate from previous school/institution
• Provisional Eligibility Certificate (issued by Department of Pre-University Education for non-Karnataka / international candidates)
• Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/BCM candidates)
• Income Certificate (if annual family income is below ₹44,500)
• Passport size photographs

*Note*: Ensure you bring the original certificates along with at least 3 attested photocopies for verification during counseling.

title: Eligibility & Cutoff Criteria
answer:
🎯 **Eligibility & Cutoff Criteria**:

• **Eligibility**: Candidates who have successfully cleared SSLC / ICSE / CBSE / 10th Standard or equivalent board.
• **Cutoff Announcement**: Cutoffs are finalized upon declaration of 10th board results and displayed on the college notice board & website.
• **Promotion Criteria (I PUC to II PUC)**: Minimum 30% marks in each individual subject and 35% overall aggregate in district-level promotional exams.
